hero_kpi_rationale: Semiconductor sector revenue represents 72% of Veeco's total revenue in 2025 and demonstrates its leadership position in advanced process equipment for the semiconductor industry, with year-over-year growth reflecting AI demand and advanced technology trends.

risks.title: Unfavorable market conditions
risks.score_rationale: Volatile market conditions have already negatively impacted operating results and could continue. The company is exposed to semiconductor market fluctuations and changes in trade policies.

risks.title: Commercial and tariff risks
risks.score_rationale: Risks of non-compliance with trade regulations, changes in trade policies, tariffs and export restrictions could affect sales, particularly to China.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cyberattack and data breach risks. Information systems could be vulnerable and compromise operations.

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: Intensified competition in the semiconductor processing equipment market. Competitors could offer similar products and services with aggressive pricing.

risks.title: Regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: Exposure to regulatory compliance risks and changes in regulatory policies, particularly for export of sensitive technologies to certain countries.

risks.title: Risks related to merger with Axcelis Technologies
risks.score_rationale: The merger with Axcelis, approved by shareholders on February 6, 2026, remains subject to regulatory approvals and closing conditions that may not be satisfied, creating operational and strategic uncertainty.

ai_positioning.summary: VEECO does not have significant mentions concerning artificial intelligence or machine learning in the provided excerpts from its 10-K/20-F report.
